caption:
Your cheque bounced? Could you really pay double?

Under the cheque-bounce law (Section 138), a court can order a fine of up to twice the cheque amount, jail of up to 2 years, or both.
After a bounce, the payee has 30 days to send you a written notice; you then have 15 days to pay.
Pay within those 15 days and a case usually can't be filed.
Illustrative: a ₹50,000 cheque can mean a fine of up to ₹1 lakh.
